Prodigiosin production peaks at **25–28 °C** and is suppressed at **≥37 °C** (page 2, citing reference [41]). Figure 2A on page 4 shows the same contrast.

The paper also attributes the temperature dependence to decreased expression and stability of PigF and PigN at higher temperatures (page 9).
question: At what temperature does prodigiosin production peak, and when is it suppressed?
